approval.decisionSource: Explicit project-owner instruction in this session: APPROVE vic-2026-prospective-observational-v1 for the exact current experimental model.
approval.fingerprintDefinition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted keys, compact separators, literal Unicode, no NaN; material rules exclude only operational status/approval/nextAction/scoring state and sealed-snapshot registry.

modelArrangement: A: exact existing model under a new prospective validation identity; no model clone.
productionStandard: PROD 1.0 gates unchanged. One 2026 election cannot replace a registered missing historical replication or establish cycle-clustered calibration. Separate governance/evidence required for any production decision.

snapshots.trigger: Approved protocol merge and witnessed seal of existing 8 October forecast; not backdated preregistration.
Official writ day/roll close at 8pm Melbourne.
Before 28 November polling day; primary scoring snapshot.

inputRules.permitted: Sources published, captured and explicitly model-admitted by cutoff under existing evidence/independence policies. Preserve source-family, undecided and verification states; no automatic admission.
inputRules.forbidden: Later publications/captures/admissions even with earlier fieldwork; target outcomes/leaks, election-night data, target-derived crosswalks/notionalisation, fitted calibration using 2026 targets, post-freeze model/seed/simulation changes.
inputRules.updates: Governed poll/candidate/ballot updates and as_of create new snapshot input hashes, not structural model variants. Only facts used by the exact engine enter its prediction. No coefficient, party mapping, uncertainty, feature-weight or counting changes.
inputRules.lateEvidence: Only later live snapshots; never overwrite sealed prediction.
inputRules.calendarCorrection: Reverify VEC before sealing; prospectively version schedule before affected cutoff and target exposure. Missed freeze remains unavailable; never recreate retrospectively.

required: UTC witness time and Melbourne cutoff
source IDs and publication/capture/admission timestamps and receipts including holds/exclusions
self-contained archived inputs, ballots/mappings and output files with SHA256
probability vectors, seat distributions and interval definitions
sealing.existingSnapshotCommandLimitation: create-forecast-snapshot.mjs indexes hashes but does not archive a self-contained input package or establish witnessed cutoff. Verified sealing implementation required before activation.
activationRequirements: comparator/scorer implementations frozen/hashed before first evaluation seal
archival receipts prove required inputs/outputs existed by cutoff

comparators.definition: Repeat official 2022 five-family district primary shares/winners under pre-2026-target boundary/ballot mappings; Council prior regional shares and family seat totals. Deterministic one-hot winner probabilities and same log-loss clipping. Missing mappings unavailable.

Apply snapshot statewide five-family forecast-minus-official-2022 shares to prior district/region shares; truncate zero and renormalise under same cutoff-safe family availability. Fixed current preference-counting prior, no local shocks or target-fit parameters. Deterministic winner probabilities. Seal exact implementation/output before activation.

metrics.winnerProbability: Mean district sum-family (p-y)^2 multiclass Brier and mean -ln(p_observed) log loss, epsilon=1e-12; disclose zero-probability events/clipping count. Accuracy ties resolved ALP,LIB_NAT,ONP,GRN,OTH_IND (current family order).
metrics.primaryVotes: Equally weighted valid district/family primary MAE in percentage points; statewide formal-vote-weighted family share errors and mean absolute error using official turnout weights only in scoring.
metrics.assemblySeats: Per-family forecast mean/median absolute error, inclusive central 80% interval coverage/width (NumPy default linear quantiles 0.1/0.9). Hung binary Brier/log loss only for pre-sealed probability/event definition. Do not assume independent family counts.
metrics.council: Regional-family primary-share MAE, family seat absolute errors/80% coverage and statewide totals; group-STV family approximation only, not candidate-order certification.
metrics.finalPairs: Only probabilities/pairs exported and sealed before cutoff; otherwise unavailable, never retrospectively reconstruct predictions.
metrics.aggregation: Only final_pre_election primary; earlier forecasts descriptive longitudinal snapshots. One election cluster, not independent districts/regions/families or repeated-election snapshots.
metrics.missing: Explicit reason/denominator/affected metric unavailable. No zero imputation, silent deletion or substitute targets/comparators. Missing required sealed probabilities or outcome mapping invalidate affected metrics.

targetUniverse.assembly: Contests held on 28 November in the 88 current districts; official certified formal votes and winner-family mapping under pre-sealed rules. Cancelled/deferred/supplementary contests remain separate, unavailable for original general-election targets, no inferred zeros.
targetUniverse.council: Eight five-member regions under actual general-election rules, family-level results; no individual candidate-order claim.
targetUniverse.hungEvent: No modelled family holds at least 45 Assembly seats (max across ALP,LIB_NAT,ONP,GRN,OTH_IND), matching forecast_2026.py. This family-aggregation event is not a claim about individual independent coordination, coalition negotiation or confidence-and-supply. If the target universe changes, disclose non-comparability.
targetUniverse.outcomeAdmission: Certified official VEC scoring-only receipt with publication/capture/hash. Incomplete results remain unavailable; writ-return date is not automatic scoring permission.

calibration.method: Ten equal-width district-family winner-probability reliability bins with non-empty counts. Descriptive within one dependent election only; no district bootstrap as election-level calibration CI, no fitted correction applied to these evaluated targets.
calibration.oneElectionLimitation: Chamber/hung calibration and cycle-clustered generalisation remain unestablished.

decisionRules.PASS: Protocol integrity only: approval before target exposure, required forecasts/comparators/scorers sealed at cutoffs, hashes/universe/missingness declared, every result including negatives retained. Not predictive-performance or production PASS.
decisionRules.FAIL: Leakage, backdating, tampered hash, undeclared structural change, dropped negative result or missing required primary forecast/comparator => execution FAIL; preserve record.
decisionRules.performance: Report all fixed scores/comparator differences descriptively, including losses. No numerical release threshold chosen for a single election.
decisionRules.stop: Pause affected evaluation on contamination/cutoff/manifest uncertainty or model change; preserve originals, no post-result replacement holdout.
decisionRules.newProtocol: Changed units, cutoffs after closure, metrics/comparators/scoring/aggregation/calibration/stopping rules require prospective protocol version before exposure. Behaviour changes require new model identity too.
decisionRules.bugFixes: Output-neutral tooling/documentation corrections may append audited amendment. Prediction-changing bug fix requires new model/protocol with original negative evidence preserved.

simulationRole.allowed: Preregister DGP, misspecification stresses, seeds, sample sizes and MC error before estimator/coverage/sensitivity/preference/chamber tests; preserve negatives.
simulationRole.cannotEstablish: Real electoral calibration, fourth empirical election or Victorian complete-model production.
